# Advait Jain

> Backend engineer — Kafka, Golang, distributed systems, event-driven
> architecture, GenAI. This site is a single-page interactive résumé driven
> from a terminal-style prompt rather than a scrolling document.

## Contact
- Email: aj.advaitj@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Zoronium
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/advaitj
- Blog: https://zoronium.hashnode.dev

## Site
- [index.html](index.html): the résumé. All content (experience, projects,
  skills, education, awards) lives in one `R` data object near the top of
  the page's script — that object is the source of truth, this file is a
  summary of it for crawlers and should not be treated as more current.
- At the prompt, `resume` prints everything in order; `grep <term>` searches
  every bullet, skill, and role by keyword.
